text: Worked just as advertised. I'm no longer frustrated with my Keurig and can access the whole menu.
Already reviewed on company's site but excellent reusable set ! Love them !! No more waste on disposable pods and helps keep a green environment.

The first order, the single use refill did not work.  I let them know and Dorothy shared some tips and when that still did not work, she sent me a new set.  Awesome service.
My husband love these because he can add his choice of coffees.
Makes a strong cup of coffee!
Water went every where on the first use. The product does not stay closed easily and is cheaply made.

For those in need of an environmental solution, these are excellent for renewable replacements of the keurig plastic cups.  In addition, it makes it possible to use your favorite coffee.  Only drawback is that they are small and filling them with coffee is a bit of a hassle, but well worth it to get away from constant plastic.
Great!  Easily filled, no overflow coffee grains like I had in my older reusable cups.  These fit right into the k cup holder just like a k cup. Don't have to take out the center ring.
quick delivery, excellent service, product works great...LOVE when expectations are met!
Great product.  Was skeptical that they would fit, but they did. Very pleased.

I only got one single serve k cup, I thought there were two, a single serve and a pot, I like it, solid construction and easy to use but disappointed that the other larger reusable cup never showed up.
They do not work with my keurig 2.0

Do not buy! These items do not work as advertised, at least in Keurig 2.0 machines. The larger (orange) pod works some of the time, and the smaller (purple) works *never*.

Look elsewhere for a product which actually works!
The orange carafe filter was missing it's lid when it came.
The product works as advertised.  I like the fact that it has an oring and that there are screens in the bottom..... Allowing the water to flow all the way through...
The individual filter is NOT recognized by k2  575

The small single serve is supposed to work with the K2 system.  It does not.  The carafe one does.  It gets a two for that.  The vendor tried extra hard to help us to get it to work but to no avail.  They even sent a replacement and some stickers that should have helped.  The replacement was no different from the first.  Now there are two single serves that don't work.  The sent some stickers to put on the single serve and they did nothing to help them work. Sooooooo........  Be aware.  I think the vendor means well and is totally interested in successful use of the product but.......it didn't work.
These are fabulous. Especially the carafe size. It's a lifesaver because the k-cups that size are getting hard to find. I definitely recommend these.
We have not used the larger reusable cup, but the purple one designed for a single cup works flawlessly.
We use both and they work great in our Keurig. I especially like the Carafe size as I can customize the coffee I make using actual fresh coffee .
I was looking for these all over my area and could never find both in same package. They are good qualify at great price
Works great does not leak coffee grounds like the one that came with my kurig.

Price was awesome. Paying for big and small pod for the price of one when you compare price in other stores.

Easy to use and saves money by putting your own coffee in!
These are nice and allows me to use regular coffee that's not a k-pod

like but have not used bought for family member

Product works great. I would definitely buy them again.

Works great!! Very happy & saving lots of money!!
Have only used the small one but it leaks if you are not very careful and I often find more grounds in my cup than with other filters.
Perfect way to use your own coffee in your keurig.

The instructions need to specify that you have to line the k-cup up in the Kuerig in such a way that does not allow the needle to poke through the bottom of the dispenser. I never got to use the smaller one because the first time out, it was damaged by the needle and is no longer usable.
The larger one is perfect for using the carafe.
works with my new Keurig  just what I needed brews my coffee just like it

Small purple pod does not not/will not work with my 2.0 system. Highly disappointed! I do not know if the carafe (larger pod) pod will work. Will update if does work.

Update: the large orange pod for the carafe works!
Works great when I want to use my own ground coffee in my Keurig 2.0 (which will not take all brands of cupped coffees).
Very disappointed. I just wanted the purple one and mine does not work at all. I tried placing it in different positions and still nothing. I did not try the orange one.
I have a keurig 2.0 and have had great success using the refillable k-cup. It's easy to use and it came with clear instructions.
Product works much better than other refillable pods on the market. Haven't had any issues.
as described
I really like these refillable cups. Also I like that the lid on the large cup pops off to make it easier to clean.
These do not work in my Keurig..fairly new red Keurig, no bells and whistles.  Have not spoken to seller yet but based on speed of delivery he gets 5 stars..will repost as necessary
Works well with my new keurig
The purple one would work in my Keurig but the orange one does not for the carafe. I thought that it would because of some to the reviews but it did not.

Best products ever! I'm saving lots of $$$ on using my own coffee instead of the higher priced K-Cup's. I love very bold dark roast coffee so it is hard to find it in the K-CPU line. I get my own beans, grind what I am going to brew and estimate I'm saving upwards of 60%. I do find that getting some of the paper filters for these helps to additionally filter out any of the sediment.
Seems to work great so far.
This have worked well for many months . We will purchase again when they wear out which will probably still take many more months.
I like the fill and save easy to use but could be easier to clean out.  But otherwise it is great

Both worked at first. The smaller purple one eventually had a hole created in the bottom which then created coffe grounds in my coffee so I threw it away. The carafe cup worked for a few months before I stared getting an error that it's not compatible with my k2.0 brewer. It does work intermittently but intermittent is not good enough for a mom who needs coffee to get a kiddo to school on time.
Junk. The carafe one which is the reason we bought this for only worked twice in our machine. I tried it my wife tried it. Doesn't work  waste of money.

These work great with my keurig!  I like that it came with  2 size cups, a filter, and a coffee scoop. I love  that these have the mesh filter with a gold finish which makes sure that no coffee passes through the filter and into your cup!  The cups are really high quality they should  last a long time.  Very happy with these cups!

Not only are these resuable and eco-friendly, but the gold mesh allows for less chemicals to enter your coffee. Works perfectly with the 2.0 version. One of the kcups arrived with a piece broken off the lid, I contacted the seller and received a response within 20 minutes. They immediately sent me a code to re-purchase the product at no cost to me. Excellent customer service, great product. My coffee has never tasted so good!!
I like this item because I can brew either a cup or carafe of any type coffee.  It does the job.
A little difficult to clean, other  than that it works great !

A wonderful Product. It paid for itself in less than one week of use! I am a coffee addicted person.
I had the much over touted European Machine, and was spending $7.00 a day at home on thimble sized coffee pods! Making Mini Cups of coffee. Thus, being required to brew large pots of coffee. Thankfully, BREW-ORO, saved the day!
Buy wise, Buy smart, Buy BREW-ORO !!!!!
Excellent Product and Quality Build for Keurig 2.0 owners who wish to brew their own favorite brand of coffee in either Carafe or Single Cup quantity.  Very easy to use and we highly recommend.
The filters work beautifully. I have purchased other brands and they only work for a few days. If these continue to work as they're supposed to, I will purchase some more.
Love these cups. They perform beautifully and are so EASY to clean.
great product better than the old ones that used to leak out.
Works great!
thanks!
I find them easy to use and my coffee taste is great. Better for the environment than K-cups.
Quick delivery of a great product!
Works just like advertised. Love mine
Exactly as advertised. Works great and already using them every day.
It is not a very durable cup but plenty serviceable for the price

This is EXACTLY what I was looking for. Used it 3 times already and didn't have any issues. I tested adding a lot of coffee and pressuring it slightly to make a stronger expresso like coffee and it works great.
Both the carafe size and the regular size work well with my Keurig 2.0.  I found that using a finer grind helps the coffee strength greatly. I can now use my own coffee.

I have bought other reusable K cups for my Keurig 2.0 and they didn't work without modification. These cups worked perfectly! In addition to coffee, they are wonderful for making Genmaicha (玄米茶, "brown rice tea").  The cups are also compatible with Perfect Pod EZ-Cup 2.0 Disposable Filters.
Now I can also use my coffee in my keurig.  So far I have only used the K Cup reusable pod and I love it. It is exactly what I hoped it would be.  My cup of coffee is great.
Great item. Anyone that has a Keurig should have a couple of sets of these

These cups are great! They are easy to use and clean and we have had zero issues (unlike the first *different brand* we had.) Our coffee tastes good and doesn't have any grounds in it. Impressed and excited to have these. Already recommended to our family.

Product is easy to use in my Keurig 560, and produces a cup of coffee of expected strength based on amount of ground coffee used, with very little fine grounds released into the cup.  Easy to empty used grounds and rinse or wash.  Only concern is the durability of the hinge on the purple single brew cup as it is simply thin plastic being flexed with every use.  The orange carafe cup has a much heftier hinge, as can be seen in the photos of the two cups.
Work great

These cups actually let the coffee grains through and it is very annoying to have the coffee at the bottom of each cup of coffee. Not impressed at all, I actually have to use filters, which defeat the entire purpose of getting these "reusable" cups.
Doesn't fit Keurig 2.0. Don't waste your time or money.
I have only used the single cup model so far. It works well so I see no reason that the larger carafe model should not work as well.
I absolutely love this product!! Coffee tastes great! Clean coffee. Kerig coffee at a fraction of the cost!!!
So glad to be able to use my own coffee.  There are wonderful.
I was pleased that the cups were so reasonably priced and easy to use.
Only one problem was that I had to figure out how to usethe cups. It came with no instructions otherwise it was great.
have only used once, but worked fine.  I did have some grounds in the bottom of the pot, but coffee tasted great.
Everything is great with the product. It is nice to have the ability to use my own coffee in my Kurig.

I have tried several other brands of reusable K Cup and K Carafe but always returned them because they allowed coffee grounds to leak out into the coffee and/or the lids would break off. Since purchasing these my coffee has been grounds free!
Works well kerg 2.0 is so picky I'm glad I found this product.

I have really enjoyed using the new K cups. I've had them for a while now and unfortunately the top came off sooner than I had hoped for. It's not much of an issue but can be misplaced fairly easy. The plastic that holds the top on wears out fairly quick. Overall though they are a great solution to an expensive coffee drinking habit.
They work great, would buy again.
They work, they save the environment.  The OEM reusable cup gives better flavor but is more expensive. Your call.

I'm so happy with my 24K gold, reusable K cups. Since our regular coffee pot broke we have been using these K cups for single cups of coffee. I like that they are not 100% plastic, they allow the coffee to drip through the grounds at a nice pace to capture the flavor. I'm going to purchase more to give as gift toppers. Cool product.
Works well, easier to clean than other reusable cups that I have.
The bigger cup has a hinge, the smaller does not.  Hasn't broken yet, but it's coming.  Just curious as to why they could not both have hinges.  No biggie, as I have another small cup with a hinge.
It filters the coffee, I drink the coffee. Buying grounds saves money and tastes better then a plastic k-pod. Good for the environment and good for the human.
The Carafe pod doesnt appear to work with my Keurig K250 2.0 system - the machine does not recognize this pod and cannot brew with it. However, the K-cup pod works wonderfully.

While I have not used the KCarafe filter yet, I have used the KCup filter several tlimes. Read the instructions on the box & don't overfill with too many coffee groungs or it'll put some "grounds sludge" in your coffee that settles to the bottom. I did that once & learned.  I love being able to use my own ground coffee & each cup I've had was very fresh tasting.  I'm grateful to have found this product as I'm not happy Keurig made their new 2.0 so that you can only use Keurig approved KCups. They have that right but I am a thrifty shopper & don't like to be forced to buy a more expensive product when I could save some money.  I will definately buy a few of these as gifts now so my family/friends can once again enjoy "the freshest" cup of Jo of the day. I feel my few cups I've had with the BrewOro tasted fresher than many KCups I've had. It cleaned up in secounds, I just emptied the grounds in my garbage & rinsed quickly under running warm water & it looked brand new, no stains.

UPDATE: The seller was awesome and refunded the price of the set!! I am extremely impressed with the customer service so I am updating my review from 2 to 3 stars.

Maybe I have a lemon? Or my machine is rejecting it? I don't know. The refillable K Cup works fine. The refillable K Carafe/Mug is terrible. I don't get the problem with the grounds in my cup like some other reviewers; but, I kind of wish I did because maybe it would result in a stronger cup of coffee. I wrote the company and was told to use less coffee (filling the carafe to 75%) and the result was watery. Then I was told to try a different brand of coffee. I use several different brands of coffee and the issue remains. I have asked the makers to suggest a specific brand that would work with it. When/if I ever get this to work, I will update my review. Until then, two stars...

I was so excited to find these reusable K-cups....so reasonably priced, a more affordable way to enjoy my keureg coffee each morning.  When I tried to use the Carafe K-Cup, my Keureg rejected the cup.  The machine noted it was not compatible for my Keureg 2.0 !  Frustrating!
It arrived on time. I was able to use the small reusable cup but not the carafe one because it was not a K-cup original. I have a k250.

So, funny story. I had these in my cart and also ordered them myself... my wife saw them in the cart and the also ordered them... this turned out to be a good thing. As this product goes, it is totally as described you dont need to hack your system for it to work. AS FOR MY FIRST ORDER... someone stole it. Now, if you are going to steal something, I would have suggested the hunting boots beside the door that were $200, or maybe my gps out of my car, or many other assorted goods that can be found around my house... but nope, they stole the reusable K-cups and a pair of gloves. As they have not returned them, I am going to take a guess and state that they also enjoyed the product and found that it was well worth my money! Cheers
Works good

K Cups worked well and make great coffee
Gives you a choice of coffee not available in regular K Cups
Excellent price for both size filters. I was looking for a carafe size filter which are difficult to locate. Both work well and I prefer reusable filters.
Excellent price for both size filters. I was looking for a carafe size filter which are difficult to locate. Both work well and I prefer reusable filters.
ok
This product works beautifully and pays for itself after just a few cups if coffee considering the price that Kuerig is charging for special kcups.
works fine, but still it's not as good as K-cups
Very happy, use my own coffee and not spend a fortune on buying k cups, have control over the intensity of your brew.

Works well and is easy to install.  Doesn't come with any directions per say.  Many people have said you have to jury rig these reusable units to get them to work.  Haven't had to so far.  One worry is the hinge point appears to be very weak and I won't be surprised if it breaks off within the next 10 uses or so.  We'll see......
These really work! Tried of few others that did not work (and with this one, you don't need stupid paper filters).
The orange pod for the carafe does not work in my keurig k475 so that was a waste of money.

I bought this specifically for the Carafe pod to use at work. It does not work! What a waste of money. The smaller k cup works but leaked a lot of coffee grounds into the cup. I thought with all the great reviews that this would be better but it was a big disappointment. Don't waste your money. Only the new Keurig machines have the carafe ability and this doesn't work with them so what is the point of selling it?!? The company itself was very kind and refunded the product. I appreciate their customer service but wished that the product actually worked.
I was using a cheaper version without the medal.  There were too many coffee grounds.  I love this one.  So nice to not keep throwing away all those pods.
Works perfectly.
Was unclear in the description that they would not work with my new Keurig. Went into a drawer

I bought these cups since it had had over 4 star reviews. Let tell you that I am putting in my carafe pod exactly as instructed and demonstrated in the pictures on Amazon. Though my Keurig keeps giving me the "oops!" message. The message only happens with the carafe cup. If you're ordering this for a Keurig 2.0 and thinking it will work since some reviews say it does and is advertised that it does - it doesn't.

Nice price for a kcup and carafe
IMO this cup does't leave that gross metallic taste in your coffee
dishwasher safe

Every thing noted this would work in ALL series 2.0 brewers.  I got a message AFTER I had received the item it doesnt work in the 575 model, which is what i purchasrd it for.

Just used the kcup one for the first time. My cup really just tastes like extremely watered down coffee, it's disgusting since I enjoy a strong cup. Not a happy customer but I'm glad these weren't as expensive as the Keurig brand eco cup.

After reading about the damage that K-cups are doing to the environment my husband and I decided to switch to a re-fillable cup.
We haven't had a need to use the larger cup but we both use the smaller cup everyday.
We have been using it for over 6 months now. It's easy to tap out the coffee grounds into the trash. I then rinse it out with water and fill it up for the next cup of coffee.
The cup has held up well and I am very happy with my purchase. I feel that the coffee even tastes better vs drinking the K-cup coffee.
love love love it.
the K-cup filter works good but the K-carafe filter only work one time out of five hundred on Keurig 475
Cheap.
Seems to work
not the right sizes

Ok, these reusable K-Cup filters are not something that will last long enough to hand down to the kids. But they do the job.
I got the large one to be able to make large cups of coffee, or full the carafe. It does that perfectly
The top is hinged and has a rubber gasket. The small one was included and I consider it a bonus.
I have had NO grounds in the coffee using these; only the regular bit of sludge.
(If you don't have sludge in your cup, it's not strong enough!!! Not just with these, but however it's made!)
The pricing is very good.
When I wear these out, I hope they will still be available. I like them
WORTHLESS!! All I keep getting is a "OOPS" error message. I have to take it out and put bake in the machine over and over again then maybe I can get it to work.  Would not recommend this product!

[[ASIN:B01DTJ2NQC 24K Gold Reusable K Cup and K Carafe Coffee Filter Pod by Breworo - Accessories for Keurig 2.0 K300, K400, K500 Series and 1.0 Brewers - Bonus Coffee Scoop]]

Description said these products would fit the Keurig K500 I have. After insertion, a response appeared saying they were not compatible. Maybe Keurig wants their own product for selling purposes or it really was not compatible. Either way, I didn't want to take a chance and ruin my new machine.
Also, the packaging by the distributor was poor. I had bought 2 sets. One set had a broken lid upon arrival.

Re: Amazon - They were very prompt at giving me a refund. Because of that, I'll continue to shop at Amazon.

Did not work well with my Keurig 2.0 machine, only the top half of the coffee grounds where wet after cleaning the filter. Also it was very difficult to clean. The gold mesh openings are too small for the brewed coffee to come out. Used fine ground coffee, the same grade I use for my stove top espresso pot. This is just my personal opinion. Will return product for a refund and will buy the original, but a bit more expensive original reusable filter. You get what you pay for.
Haven't used but I like the gold , healthy
Very happy with product
I have had a couple of months, the small k cup lid has already broken off.

This product is beautiful and beautifully made. Easy to use. Easy to clean. It makes the pour over process easy, and the coffee tastes better. I no longer have to worry about running out of paper filters.
Works great

So far this filter is working perfectly.  I use it for more than just coffee, I make coconut milk, kombucha and other things that require filtering.  Depending on the size of the material needing to be filtered it works well saving me money on filters.

Works as well as the paper filters for my Chemex
Fantastic intro email on proper use!

My son-in-law , a culinary chef, introduced me to your filter. And, I absolutely love it!
I use it with my new Chemex coffee maker.
works great

Yep! very happy with this one! I tried a flannel reusable filter and was diligent about cleaning it but over time the flannel filter would take longer and longer to filter that by the end of it, my coffee would be luke-warm.

This filter gives great and pure taste! Filters pretty quick and is amazing!

I bought a Hario v60 size 1 however I don't like having to reorder paper filters all the time and they don't carry them in the stores. I found this filter and while it's not specifically designed to work with the Hario it fits and works beautifully :-)

I've been using it for around a week now. The day after I received it I also received an email with some instruction on the grind and to be careful not to use a fine grind but more a fine/coarse grind. Which it just so happens was what I found works perfectly for me with the pour over method.

It's easy to use and easy to clean.
Great coffee filter! Gift for aunt with her new Chemex coffee maker. She loved the new filter with its fine mesh design!
This filter turned out to be better than I was expecting.  The coffee is clear, no sediment.
It is the perfect paperless coffee filter at long last! Very pleased!
Works great! I love that I don't have the waste of paper filters any longer and my coffee tastes better than ever.
Love this filter! I noticed a difference in the taste of my coffee with the first use. Cleans up beautifully.
great design.  fits perfectly with my Chemex.  easy to clean and most importantly, great tasting coffee.
This reusable filter works as expected with my Chemex and seems like it is constructed well and should last a long time. Happy that I can stop buying paper filters.
Liquid moves too fast through the filter. Coffee tastes horribly watered down. I would not recommend this product unless you prefer that your coffee taste more like tea.

I returned the filter because water didn't filter through it it just went right through the bottom making my coffee weak and more like tea than a strong cup of brewed coffee. I even changed up the grind of my coffee but no matter how coarse or fine it was still weak. Sad to be going back to paper filters.
